smtpDelivery.scope: Real application workers and SMTP transport to owned local capture only; no Internet delivery or remote mailbox certification

cpuDelta.scope: Per-process cgroup CPU deltas over resource snapshot interval; includes diagnostic overhead. Full-stack/admission interval also includes configured preflight and warmup.

memoryProfiles.scope: 500ms diagnostic Node/cgroup samples, copied before shutdown; inspector overhead, not certification
500ms diagnostic Node/cgroup samples, copied before shutdown; inspector overhead, not certification

admissionStageMetrics.scope: Authenticated process-lifetime histograms after load. Acquire includes pool checkout and BEGIN; finalize includes driver handoff and commit/rollback, not pure WAL time. Idle processes may have empty event histograms. Fixed labels and numeric buckets only.
